title: Advanced Special Topics in Women, Gender, and Sexuality Studies; Dickinson, Erotics, Poetics, Biopics: Some (Queer) Ways We Read Poetry
description: Prerequisite: Two English courses in literature; or permission of ARHU-English department. Cross-listed with ENGL439D and LGBT448Y. Credit only granted for ENGL439D, LGBT448Y, or WMST498Y.
